newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka blue chips fall on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka blue chips fall on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lankan blue chips fell on Monday due to selling by small investors, brokers said.
John Keells Holdings Ltd fell 10 rupees to 380, National Development Bank Ltd five to 285 and Sampath Bank Ltd one to 85.
"Since prices of these blue chips have eased on small volumes, it is most likely that retail investors are booking profits," said a broker.
Profit-taking by retail investors began on Friday, after Colombo's main stock index gained over 70 points during July, brokers said. On Friday, the all-share index closed 3.9 points down to 865.8
